claim.claim-text: 1. A method for determining a steering angle that is a rotational angle of a steering wheel in a steer-by-wire steering device of a vehicle, the method for determining a steering angle comprising:

2. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, the method comprising causing, after determining the steering angle, a rotational angle of the steering wheel to match a steering position of a steered wheel of the vehicle, the steering position being a position corresponding to a steered shaft of the steering device.

3. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 2, wherein a rotational position of the steering wheel corresponding to the steering position of the steered wheel is caused to match the steering position in such a manner that the rotational position forms an angle in accordance with a predetermined steering angle ratio.

4. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 3, wherein the method for determining a steering angle does not include determining the steering angle by temporarily storing a first end angle when the steering wheel is rotated in the first direction and temporarily storing a second end angle when the steering wheel is rotated in the second direction, and then steering the steered wheel until the rotational position of the steering wheel is caused to match the steering position of the steered wheel.

5. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, wherein determining the steering angle includes calculating the steering angle based on an angle range that is obtained from the first end angle and the second end angle on an assumption that the first end angle and the second end angle are limited to an operation range of the steering wheel.
6. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, wherein the steering wheel is rotated in the first direction or the second direction through control on the reaction force motor.

7. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, wherein the detecting of the load on the reaction force motor is performed through detection of a current supplied to the reaction force motor while the steering wheel is rotated in the first direction or the second direction through control on the reaction force motor.

8. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, wherein the method comprising starting to rotate the steering wheel in the first direction after rotating the steering wheel is indicated through an informing device.

9. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, wherein a rotational range of the steering wheel is within a range restricted by a stopper mechanism for providing a limit to the steering angle.

10. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, wherein the first end angle and the second end angle are detected by a reaction force control unit for controlling the reaction force motor through a sensor that detects a state variable having a correlation with the rotational angle of the steering wheel.
11. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, the method comprising determining the steering angle before operation of the vehicle is started.
12. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 11, the method comprising

determining that the operation of the vehicle has not been started yet when a determined condition is established, wherein the condition includes a power source switch of the vehicle being switched from off to on.

13. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, the method comprising detecting a steering torque applied to a steering shaft through an operation to rotate the steering wheel while the steering wheel is rotated in the first direction or the second direction, wherein the temporarily storing of the end angle includes setting, as a condition, detecting the increase in the load on the reaction force motor and detecting a state in which the steering wheel is not operated by an operator based on the steering torque.
14. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 13, wherein

the detecting of the increase in the load on the reaction force motor includes a result that a current supplied to the reaction force motor is equal to or more than a current threshold value by comparing the current and the current threshold value, and the detecting of the state in which the steering wheel is not operated by the operator includes a result that the steering torque is equal to or less than a torque threshold value by comparing the steering torque and the torque threshold value.
15. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 1, the method comprising

detecting a steering torque applied to a steering shaft through an operation to rotate the steering wheel while the steering wheel is rotated in the first direction or the second direction, wherein the temporarily storing of the end angle includes setting, as a condition, detecting the increase in the load on the reaction force motor, detecting a state in which the steering wheel is not operated by an operator based on the steering torque, and detecting a state in which the steering wheel is not operated by the operator based on a steering angular speed that indicates a change in the steering angle.
16. The method for determining a steering angle according to claim 15, wherein

the detecting of the increase in the load on the reaction force motor includes a result that a current supplied to the reaction force motor is equal to or more than a current threshold value by comparing the current and the current threshold value, and the detecting of the state in which the steering wheel is not operated by the operator includes a result that the steering torque is equal to or less than a torque threshold value by comparing the steering torque and the torque threshold value and a result that the steering angular speed is equal to or less than an angular speed threshold value by comparing the steering angular speed and the angular speed threshold value.
17. A controller for controlling a steer-by-wire steering device of a vehicle, wherein

the steering device has a configuration in which a power transfer path between the reaction force unit to which a steering wheel is coupled and a steering unit configured to steer a steered wheel is separated, the reaction force unit includes a reaction force motor that generates torque for rotating the steering wheel, the controller is configured to execute a steering angle determining process of determining a steering angle that is a rotational angle of the steering wheel, the steering angle determining process includes: a process of rotating the steering wheel in a first direction or a second direction; a process of detecting a load on the reaction force motor while rotating the steering wheel in the first direction or the second direction; a process of temporarily storing, when an increase in the load on the reaction force motor is detected, an end angle that is the steering angle when the increase is detected; and a process of determining the steering angle based on the end angle, and

the process of temporarily storing the end angle is a process of temporarily storing a first end angle when the steering wheel is rotated in the first direction and then temporarily storing a second end angle when the steering wheel is rotated in the second direction.
